verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Persona supports database-based verification methods (e.g., 'database lookups' in persona-docs-12) and various no-document report types like Address Lookup, Watchlist, PEP, and Adverse Media (persona-docs-15, 25, 28) that can run without a document scan. However, there is no explicit mention of SSN verification, national ID registry checks, or credit-header (bureau) based identity verification, which are the specific mechanisms named in the story. Missing for 10: explicit SSN verification flow, national registry lookup details, credit-header/bureau-based verification documentation, and independent confirmation these no-doc checks work end-to-end.
